en: The image shows an open field with a few tents and small structures scattered across the grass. In the background, there are several large wooden frameworks or towers, possibly part of an unfinished or temporary structure. A handful of people can be seen walking or standing around. The image is black and white and has a wide white border, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
